The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what I built:

**Structure** (`/workspace/output/`):
- `CMakeLists.txt` — CMake build config (C++20, std-lib only)
- `src/main.cpp` — CLI driver, orchestration
- `src/bib.{hpp,cpp}` — `.bib` parser (entries, `@string`, `@preamble`, `@comment`)
- `src/bst.{hpp,cpp}` — `.bst` lexer/parser (top-level commands, function bodies)
- `src/interp.{hpp,cpp}` — stack machine, all 37 built-ins, crossref resolution
- `src/name.{hpp,cpp}` — author-name parsing (Forms 1/2/3), `format.name$`, `width$` (cmr10), `purify$`, `change.case$`, `text.length$`, `text.prefix$`, `add.period$`
- `src/output.{hpp,cpp}` — output buffer with 79-col line wrapping
- `src/aux.{hpp,cpp}` — cite-list and `.aux` file parsing
- `src/json.{hpp,cpp}` — JSON log and error output
- `src/util.{hpp,cpp}` — file IO, lowercase, predefined month macros
- `src/types.hpp` — common types (Warning, BibEntry, StackValue, Op)

**Verified behaviors**:
- All four canonical styles (`plain`, `alpha`, `unsrt`, `abbrv`) produce reasonable output on a variety of test inputs
- Line wrapping at column 79 with backward + forward scan
- Crossref inheritance (one level), cycle detection, missing target warnings
- Special characters (`{\AE}`, `{\'e}`, `{\H{o}}`) preserved through name formatting and labels
- Author-name parsing for all three forms incl. multi-token von, Jr, brace-protected tokens
- Discretionary tie handling and tilde/hyphen separators preserved from source
- Title-case capitalization with `: `-after-colon preservation
- All spec warning kinds emitted with proper structure
- All exit codes (0/1/2) per spec
- aux file `\citation{a,b,c}` extraction
- Mixed case in `.bib` and `.bst` names handled (case-insensitive)
- Builds cleanly with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` from `output/`.
